issue_context.title: `swc_ecma_utils::BindingCollector` does not handle array, rest, and object binding patterns
issue_context.body:
### Describe the bug

For example, if you have a variable declaration like the following:

```ts
const { test } = { test: 5 };
```

The result of `swc_ecma_utils::collect_decls` will be empty. I believe it should contain this declaration?

See here:

https://github.com/swc-project/swc/blob/e5604c3e56e8ebdc96d4a15e1610f5dbcae09876/crates/swc_ecma_utils/src/lib.rs#L2244-L2249

### Expected behavior

I believe it should return results for these types of declarations

### Version

latest main
comments: This closed issue has been automatically locked because it had no new activity for a month. If you are running into a similar issue, please create a new issue with the steps to reproduce. Thank you.

review_comments: I believe this does not fix the issue completely (ex. array patterns). I will open a PR.

Oh, thanks!
I thought it was enough.
I think we need to handle `const [ test ] = asdf;`. I'm just writing a test to confirm it.

Thanks @kdy1! It is actually working. My bad! I misread the code—ArrayPatterns have elements that are `Pat` and so it will visit those identifiers.

I'm going to submit my tests in a PR though 🙂
